svg.title: One classic prompt splitting into speaker and reasoner instructions
svg.desc: Conceptual illustration. A bundle of ten parallel lines, one for each sentence of the example classic system prompt, runs in from the left. Midway, the lines cross and sort themselves into two bundles, labelled Speaker at the top right and Reasoner at the bottom right. A single mint line, the rule never to say a booking is done before the tool confirms it, forks in two and appears in both bundles.
